description: The entity does not identify and assess changes that could significantly impact the system of internal control.
applicability: Applies to all entities when changes to systems, processes, or the business environment are not assessed for control impacts, change management processes are absent, or control updates are not triggered by significant changes.

metadata.detection_notes: Review change management procedures, control impact assessments for changes, documentation of business model changes, technology changes, regulatory changes, and evidence that controls are updated in response to changes. Look for absence of change impact assessments or controls not updated after significant changes.
